grammarRule.formula: If + Subject + Present Simple (V1), Subject + will + V1 (Base verb)

explanation.ml: ഭാവിയിൽ ഒരു കാര്യം സംഭവിച്ചാൽ മറ്റൊന്ന് സംഭവിക്കാൻ സാധ്യതയുണ്ട് എന്ന് പറയാൻ First Conditional ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. If-ക്ലോസിൽ Present Simple ഉം മെയിൻ ക്ലോസിൽ Will + V1 ഉം വരും.
explanation.en: Master First Conditional: Real Future Possibilities with clear formula: If + Subject + Present Simple (V1), Subject + will + V1 (Base verb)

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: If-ക്ലോസിൽ ഒരിക്കലും 'will' ഉപയോഗിക്കരുത്. 'If it rains, I will stay' (NOT 'If it will rain, I will stay').
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: If-ക്ലോസിൽ ഒരിക്കലും 'will' ഉപയോഗിക്കരുത്. 'If it rains, I will stay' (NOT 'If it will rain, I will stay').

nouns.definition: A thing that is required as a prior condition for something else to happen or exist.
nouns.example: Passing advanced calculus is an essential prerequisite for quantum mechanics courses.

nouns.definition: Expected or expecting to be something specified in the future.
nouns.example: The university hosted an orientation tour for prospective international students.

nouns.definition: Possible to do easily or conveniently.
nouns.example: Building an underwater tunnel between the islands is technically feasible.

nouns.definition: A set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.
nouns.example: Working abroad gave her a rare opportunity to master foreign languages.

nouns.definition: The extent to which something is probable; the likelihood of something happening or being the case.
nouns.example: There is a strong probability that seasonal monsoon showers will arrive early.

nouns.definition: Expressing approval; giving a result that is in one's favor or advantageous.
nouns.example: Favorable currency exchange rates bolstered regional agricultural exports.

traps.question: Find the error: 'If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the outdoor picnic.'
options: 'will rain' should be 'rains' in the if-clause.
traps.explanationMl: First Conditional ലെ If-ക്ലോസിൽ 'will' ഉപയോഗിക്കരുത്, Present Simple രൂപമായ 'rains' ആണ് ഉപയോഗിക്കേണ്ടത് ('If it rains tomorrow').

traps.question: Choose the grammatically correct First Conditional sentence:
options: If you study diligently, you will clear the examination.
If you will study diligently, you clear the examination.
If you study diligently, you cleared the examination.
If you studied diligently, you will clear the examination.
traps.explanationMl: If + present simple (study), will + base verb (will clear) ആണ് കൃത്യമായ ഫോർമുല.

traps.question: Which modal can replace 'will' in the main clause to express possibility instead of certainty?
traps.explanationMl: ഉറപ്പില്ലാത്ത സാധ്യത പറയാൻ 'will' ന് പകരം 'may' അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 'might' ഉപയോഗിക്കാം ('If it rains, we may stay home').
